_comment: Discovery source registry. Each entry defines a site to monitor for new article URLs.

_schema.name: Human-readable source name
_schema.baseUrl: Homepage URL — used for auto-discovery and as a fallback
_schema.active: Set false to disable without removing
_schema.autoDiscover: If true (default), the service will probe the homepage for RSS/sitemap links
_schema.feeds: Explicit RSS/Atom feed URLs — overrides auto-discovery if provided
_schema.sitemaps: Explicit sitemap URLs — overrides auto-discovery if provided
_schema.sitemapDepth: How deep to recurse into sitemap indexes (default 2)
_schema.urlFilter: Optional regex — only URLs matching this pattern will be added to the registry
_schema.frequency: Passed through to url.json entries: daily | weekly | monthly
_schema.notes: Appended to the notes field of discovered entries
